Twelve words instead of an address, a key and a token.

## ✨ Added

- **Join a group with a connection phrase.** Read the twelve words off any KnightLoader you already run, type them into the app, and every instance in that group appears at once. No address to look up, no relay key to copy, no API token to paste, and nothing to sign into.
- **The phone is a full group member now**, not a client pointed at one machine. It derives the same key its siblings derive and dials the same relay, and that is what authenticates it - so an instance with a password set is reachable without a token, where before every single one needed its own pasted by hand.
- **Everything at once, not one per visit.** The old screen saved exactly one instance per trip through the form, so three machines meant three trips. Joining adds all of them, and re-joining with the same phrase does not duplicate the rows it already has.
- **A mistyped word is caught before anything is dialled**, and named: "word 3 (\"recieve\") is not one of the accepted words", in your own language, rather than a connection that silently never finds anybody. The wordlist is BIP39's, so no two words share their first four letters and none are near-homophones - it survives being read down a phone line and typed on a phone keyboard.

## ⚡ Improved

- **The app reads only what it needs to match an instance's look.** It used to fetch that instance's entire settings document to pick seven colour and shape fields out of it. There is a small endpoint for exactly those now, so the download paths and the configured connections stay where they belong.
- **One kind of QR on the connect screen.** The scanner used to have to tell an address code apart from a pairing code before it knew what it had scanned. There is one kind again, and the scanned text is the address.

## 🗑️ Removed

- **Pairing codes.** The connection phrase does what they did and covers every instance at once instead of one peer per code, so the redeem field, the pairing QR and the card that held them are gone. The phrase is entered once, on the connect screen.

## 📋 Notes

- **`versionCode` is 3.** It goes up on every build handed to anybody - it is what Android decides upgrade order by, and two builds sharing one are indistinguishable to a phone.
- **The phrase reaches every instance in its group**, which is the thing to understand before reading it out or putting it on a phone that might get lost. Leaving the group on this device does not revoke it for anybody else: a phrase is a group, not a per-device credential.
- **The relay never learns the phrase.** What the app sends is a hash of it, so whoever runs the relay - us, or you - cannot work backwards to the words.
- **What a group member may reach is a fixed list**, not the whole API: downloads, links and the queue, plus reading whether a password is set, who else is in the group, and that instance's own accent. Not its settings, not its accounts, not its phrase.
